items.text: Explain what serverless computing means and why there are still servers involved
Describe the AWS Lambda execution model — containers, cold starts, and lifecycle
Explain what a Lambda cold start is and when it occurs
State Lambda's maximum timeout (15 min) and the API Gateway timeout (29 sec, unchangeable)
Describe DynamoDB Streams — what it captures and how long it retains records (24 hrs)
Explain the SNS pub/sub model — topics, publishers, subscribers
Describe why an SNS email subscription requires confirmation before messages are delivered
Explain what an IAM execution role is and why every Lambda function requires one
Describe the Single Responsibility Principle and why two Lambda functions are better than one combined function here
Explain how Amazon Cognito enables dashboard access without IAM user accounts
Created a Lambda function from scratch with a custom execution role and Python 3.12 runtime
Pasted and deployed Lambda code — and remembered to click Deploy
Created an S3 bucket with a globally unique name
Configured an S3 event notification to trigger a Lambda function on object creation
Uploaded a CSV file to S3 and verified the Lambda processed it by checking DynamoDB
Created an SNS topic and confirmed an email subscription
Created a second Lambda function with a DynamoDB Streams trigger
Ran an end-to-end test and received an out-of-stock email alert
Used CloudWatch Logs to debug Lambda execution issues
Set up personal account IAM roles via Console, CLI, or CloudFormation
Created DynamoDB Inventory table with Store (partition key) and Item (sort key) with Streams enabled
Created Lambda-Load-Inventory-Role with S3 read and DynamoDB write permissions
Created Lambda-Check-Stock-Role with DynamoDB Streams read and SNS publish permissions
Deployed Load-Inventory and Check-Stock Lambda functions in personal account
Cleaned up all resources after lab to avoid unnecessary AWS charges
Can identify which event source triggers which Lambda function in a serverless pipeline
Can explain the difference between Lambda timeout and API Gateway timeout
Know that DynamoDB Streams retains records for 24 hours
Know that S3 bucket names must be globally unique
Understand that Cognito (not IAM) is used for external application user authentication
